messages:
maya: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged a weird spike on the 'customer-qa' promptset. Fail rate jumped from 2.1% -> 12.8% overnight. Looks concentrated on a small subset of prompts that ask for short factual lists. https://dash.redwood/evals/weekly
serena: ugh. did we flip a tokenizer or vocab mapping in the quant build?
james: which build? dedicated int8 candidate that landed last night (model v2.1-int8-2026-03-02)
maya: that one. quick diff I ran: float16 (v2.1-fp16) vs int8 candidate. failures are often: truncated lists or repeating "N/A" tokens. sample output: ```float16: ["1. apples", "2. bananas"]\nint8: ["1. apples", "2. N/A", "2. N/A", "2. N/A"]```
rob: can you paste the eval histogram?
maya: pasted (condensed): 
- 900 prompts pass
- 110 prompts intermittent failures
- 50 prompts hard fails (same faulty pattern)
Eval metrics: pass_rate_fp16=0.978, pass_rate_int8=0.872, avg_logprob_drop=0.45
james: avg_logprob drop of 0.45 is suspicious but not catastrophic — could be tokenization offset or kv-cache desync during decoding. Did we change kv-stride or caching code in runtime?
serena: i checked release notes for the runtime: small change to kv eviction threshold landed in eng-runtime yesterday (PR #4321). Not sure it would produce repeated N/A.
elaine: deploy-bot: canary rollout for v2.1-int8-2026-03-02 started at 2026-03-01T22:10Z to pool "nightly" (20% traffic).
rob: eval-bot: ran targeted promptset against canary pool at 2026-03-02T02:00Z — reproduces regression at 9/100. Logs attached: token sequence shows repeated  token and then fallback tokens.
maya: thanks — attaching tokenizer version: tokenizers==0.13.7 on float16, tokenizers==0.14.0 on int8 build (aha)
james: that's likely. tokenizer bump + quantization can change bytepair merges or offsets; certain short-list prompts are sensitive to split boundaries.
serena: agree. quick repro: run `python eval_client.py --model v2.1-int8-2026-03-02 --prompts customer-qa --seed 42` -> observe repeated filler on items 7-12.
maya: mitigation proposal: 1) pin tokenizer to 0.13.7 in the int8 candidate and rerun canary 2) add an eval gate: fail if pass_rate drop > 3% vs baseline 3) rollback production canary to float16 for non-deterministic promptset until verified
james: +1 to pin + gate. also suggest adding a unit test that exercises short-list token boundaries (small prompts with enumerations) so future tokenizer bumps are caught in CI.
rob: I can run a quick pinned-int8 build locally with tokenizers 0.13.7 and hit the same eval overnight. starting now. ETA ~2h.
elaine: deploy-bot: paused canary to 0% at 2026-03-02T03:10Z per request from @maya
maya: action items captured: 
- ROB: run pinned-int8 eval and upload artifacts (logs + token diffs) — due today EOD
- JAMES: add CI gate for "short-list" promptset + pass_rate threshold — quick PR by tomorrow
- SERENA: coordinate with runtime to audit KV-cache change (PR #4321) for any interactions with quant path
- MIDDLEWARE: (ops) rollback production canary to v2.1-fp16 for public routes until green

rob: uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/1765432190/pinned-int8-token-diffs.tar.gz — initial run shows pinned-int8 recover pass_rate to 97.6% (close to fp16).
james: nice. will open PR to CI gating: add nightly-shortlist check and fail pipeline when relative pass_rate drop > 3%, also add tokenization-version pin enforcement for quant builds.
serena: runtime team will do a quick audit; if kv-change interacts with cached kv shape for quant kernels we'll flag for revert.
maya: short postmortem draft notes for later: root cause = tokenizer version bump interacting with int8 quantization tokenization boundaries; secondary factor = canary still at nonzero traffic while gating rules absent. mitigation = pin tokenizer in quant builds, new CI gating rule, immediate canary pause + rollback.
james: timeline proposal: roll forward pinned-int8 to canary after CI gate added and quick runtime audit — target tomorrow morning 09:00 UTC
elaine: noted, I’ll schedule the canary window and ensure automatic fallback if pass rate dips.
maya: thanks all. follow-up meeting in #eng-ml tomorrow 09:30 to confirm rollout plan. :thumbsup:
